Experience spans Google Ads and Microsoft Ads, multi-channel media, SEO/SEM, e-commerce operations, conversion tracking, attribution, forecasting, statistical modeling, automation, database/reporting systems, website development, and cross-functional leadership. Combines marketing strategy with strong technical capability in Python, SQL, JavaScript, VBA, APIs, data visualization, and modern AI-assisted workflows. Known for learning quickly, building scalable systems, translating complex analysis into practical business recommendations, and improving both marketing performance and operational efficiency. Extremely proficient in using Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude, and many other supplemental AI systems. I use all of this AI to enhance my foundational knowledge and amplify output.
